items.title: How is the US economy really doing under President Trump?
items.summary: President Donald Trump has been boasting about the performance of the US economy ahead of the midterm congressional elections, claiming he has boosted incomes, reduced inflation and created jobs Trump has repeatedly said: "We have the hottest country anywhere in the world." While the overall US economy is faring better than many expected after Trump launched his sweeping "Liberation Day" tariffs in 2025, there's evidence those import taxes and the impact of the US-Israel war with Iran have pushed up inflation, with the harmful effects felt by most American households The US economy is also being helped by an AI investment boom, and could falter if that spending were to dry up So how does all this feel for the average American?

items.title: Gemfields records 52 million dollars in revenue from ruby auction
items.summary: Maputo, 20 Oct (AIM) – The London-based mining company Gemfields has recorded total revenue of 52 million dollars as a result of the latest mixed-quality ruby auction held by Montepuez Ruby Mining (MRM). Gemfields owns 75 per cent of MRM, the main ruby mining company in Mozambique, which employs over 1900people, of whom approximately 95 percent were Mozambican. In a statement, the company revealed 564.54 per carat was the average selling price, and 90 of the 99 lots offered for sale were sold, representing a sell-through rate of 90.9 percent. “102,099 carats were offered for sale, of which 92,153 were sold, representing 90 percent of the total. This result will help strengthen the company’s liquidity and support the continuation of its operations during a period marked by significant operational and financial constraints”, reads the statement.

items.title: BLOOM: British-Mozambican artist Fiona Wishman Oliveira explores femininity through painting and embroidery
items.summary: In BLOOM, Wishman Oliveira combines oil painting with textile elements, incorporating embroidered details and wool threads that extend beyond the edges of the canvas. The dialogue between paint, thread and texture creates depth, movement and a tactile dimension in each portrait. Through her depictions of women, the artist reflects on the complexity of the female experience, exploring strength and vulnerability, individual expression and personal growth. The title BLOOM evokes the idea of continual growth and transformation, embracing the many moments of womanhood Photo: Instagram/ccma.goethe.maputo.de Wishman Oliveira is a British-Mozambican visual artist based in Maputo, where she has been developing her artistic practice since 2009. Her work focuses on contemporary portraiture andmixed media, combining oil painting, embroidery and textile materials to create a distinctive visual language. Her works are held in private collections in Brazil, Australia, the United States, Canada, France and the United Kingdom.

items.title: Canada: Alberta rejects separation bid, CBC projects
items.summary: Voters have decisively rejected a proposal to begin the legal process toward Alberta's independence, dealing a major blow to a movement driven largely by economic grievances Canada's Alberta province has overwhelmingly rejected a plan to begin the process of seeking independence from Canada Canadian public broadcaster CBC projects a decisive victory for the federalist side, with official results showing more than 76% support for remaining in Canada after roughly a third of the votes had been counted According to unofficial results from the chief provincial electoral office, Elections Alberta, nearly 77% favored staying with Canada with roughly one million votes counted, whereas 23% sought independenced The nonbinding referendum asked residents whether they wanted to stay in Canada or start the legal steps needed for a future binding vote on separation.

items.title: Canadian tourist found guilty of animal cruelty after stealing Las Vegas flamingo from enclosure
items.summary: Fairbarn was seen on CCTV in an elevator on the way to his hotel room with the flamingo A Canadian man has been found guilty of animal cruelty after he took a flamingo from its enclosure in Las Vegas and brought it back to his hotel room during an alcohol-fuelled bender Mitchell Fairbarn, who was visiting the US city, took the Chilean flamingo named Peachy from the Flamingo Las Vegas Hotel and Casino in March Videos shown at his trial showed a smiling Fairbarn carrying the bird by the neck as he took a lift to his room. He testified that he had drunk 30 to 40 beers before the incident and said he never meant to harm the animal.

items.title: Can diplomacy stop another Ethiopia-Eritrea war?
items.summary: Ethiopia has installed a new administration in conflict-hit Tigray after federal forces pushed back Tigrayan fighters. But tensions with Eritrea continue to raise fears of a wider regional war Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed has announced an interim government in the country's northern Tigray region, giving it six months to prepare for regional elections and restore stability Abiy's announcement on Friday followed a military offensive launched in September by the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) and six other armed groups.
